ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34D.2.4 Slim Baseline
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT T34-D.2.4 Slim Baseline for RimWorld 1.5. Keeps the measured high-yield package-local merge, slow-search, reservation, validator, reachability and GenClosest transaction filters. Removes candidate fabrics, worker validators, tick/frame infrastructure, path-topology bookkeeping and overlapping GenClosest routers. Production search never waits for a worker.
